visual.general_description: Grayscale coronal CT slice of the abdomen and pelvis with printed scanner annotations.
visual.detailed_description: Single coronal CT image with contrast on a black background. Printed header text at upper right reads "CT ABDOMEN AND PELVIS WITH CONTRAST", "Plain 0.5mm AiCE 3.000 Coronal STDBHC" and "Coronal". Orientation letters R at image left, L at image right and I at the bottom center are printed, as are window and level settings, slice thickness, tube current and voltage values, and a date and time stamp at the lower right. The abdomen shows several gas-containing bowel loops. In the lower image-left (R side) abdomen there are elongated loops with mottled gas and content, and loops with gas and gray fluid-density content lie centrally and toward image right. A rounded homogeneous gray structure sits at the lower midline. The liver region and body wall are visible at the upper left and edges. No arrows, panel letters, measurements or calipers are present.
